data.title: 泽塔 · 湖畔交接后的湿身
data.description: 情报交接完成的湖畔，泽塔从浅水区起身，豹纹泳装湿透贴在身上。她甩了甩金色长发的水珠，紫眸扫过湖岸确认没有尾巴跟踪——任务结束，猫要回家了。
data.action: 从浅水区起身回眸，湿发甩动，泳装贴身
data.lighting: sparkling midsummer sunlight on lake water
data.promptProse: Rising from the shallows after the handoff, adult Zeta shakes water from her golden hair, her wet leopard swimsuit clinging, purple eyes sweeping the shore one last time.
data.animaCaption: The capsule is delivered, the shore is clean. Zeta shakes off the lake and vanishes into summer.
